subject: Post-call econ recap + VPC licensing & environment count — next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call econ recap + VPC licensing & environment count — next steps

Thanks again for the discussion today — quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can put together a tailored private/VPC proposal. High level notes from our call: 

- Pilot volume: you indicated ~60–80M tokens/month for the Q1 pilot (inference-only traffic).
- Unit economics target: you mentioned wanting to be around ~$1,200 per 1M tokens for pilot unit cost, with flexibility depending on quantization and dedicated instance count.
- Key blockers: legal/contract review and internal procurement approval cycle (you estimated ~3 weeks).
- Environments: you said you need at least Prod + Staging, and want optional DR environment during pilot.

Open items we need from your side to put a formal quote together: 
1) Confirm expected committed monthly tokens for pilot (pick low/expected/high).
2) Confirm desired support tier (standard vs premium — premium includes 24/7 oncall and quarterly runbooks).
3) Confirm whether you want a time-limited pilot term (30/60/90 days) vs a 12-month committed contract for discounted unit pricing.
4) Any procurement/legal PO terms we should be aware of (SOW, standard redlines, SOC2 addendum requests).

Attached: redwood_vpc_pricing_v1.pdf — rough licensing + per-token examples (ballpark only).

Proposed next step: 30-min sync on Friday to lock environment count and agree on a pilot commitment so we can convert this into a draft quote. Are you available Fri 11/5 10:00am PT?

Thanks,
Neha

Thanks, Neha — good recap. A few quick answers: 

- Pilot committed volume: low 60M / expected 70M / high 85M tokens per month. Planning to size for expected 70M but want headroom.
- Budget: procurement has prelim approval for $30k–$40k/month for the pilot; that includes licensing + infra support. If we can get closer to your higher-volume discounts, procurement will push toward $40k.
- Unit target: engineering/finance are targeting ~$1,200 per 1M tokens as a blended all-in number for pilot (this includes support & base license amortized). We understand discounts apply for longer commitments.
- Support: leaning premium for the first 60 days (oncall + runbook) and then evaluate.
- Environments: must have Prod + Staging. DR depends on cost; if premium/DR bundling makes sense we will consider it.

Procurement note: we have a standard Master Services Agreement template. I can send the redlines after we have a target quote.

I can do Fri 11/5 10am PT — please send calendar invite.

Cheers,
Zakaria Khan

zak@orionai.com

Subject: RE: Post-call econ recap + VPC licensing & environment count — internal notes

Neha — drafting options below to bring to the call. I attached a lightweight CSV with line-item examples. Key assumptions called out.

Option A — Subscription + per-token:
- Base subscription (monthly): $7,500 (includes management/control plane + base support)
- Per-token rate (pilot): $1,350 per 1M tokens (applies after 10M free tokens)
- Environments included: Prod + Staging. DR is add-on ($1,200/month).
- Support: Standard included; Premium add-on $4,000/month (24/7 + named TAM + quarterly runbooks).

Option B — Term license (12mo committed) + lower per-token:
- One-time platform license amortized monthly: $20k/month (gives capacity guarantees & private control-plane)
- Per-token rate: $950 per 1M tokens for committed volumes (70M target), with stepped discounts above 100M.
- Environments: Prod + Staging + DR included at that commitment level.
- Support: Premium included for first 90 days; then standard.

Notes: 
- The $1,200 target Zak mentioned aligns reasonably with Option B when accounting for amortized license and support.
- We should price both with clear delta for DR and premium support so procurement can see trade-offs.

I will prep a short one-pager to share in the call with Zak. Ben — can you confirm what our standard SLA uplift looks like for DR-enabled private deployments (latency/uptime SLOs)?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

- Confirm pilot committed band (low/expected/high) and pick the pricing option to model.
